text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Mohamed told Spanish newspaper El Pais ahead of official visit to Spain there is wide cooperation between the two countries.
- Agenda of Moroccan-Egyptian commission, expected to meet on Tuesday, will give priority to investments, culture and education.
- Crown Prince Mohamed says 'we would like a Spanish economic presence of better quality'.
- King Hassan sends condolence message to Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani over victims of earthquake.
- Sahrawi human rights commission says Western Sahara issue can only be solved within the framework of a united Morocco.
- Now that the division into constituencies has been completed political parties are expected to raise curtain on programmes.
- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak's visit to Morocco will pave the way for new cooperation.
- Morocco and Chad vow to raise level of cooperation.
